properties.comment: This is a message from Volunteer Energy Cooperative. Please be advised that a planned power outage will occur in your area on Thursday, November 12th beginning at 9:00 AM and lasting until approximately 11:00 AM. This outage is necessary to allow crews to safely replace equipment. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience. Thank you.
A crew is assigned and working to restore the power outage in your area. This outage is necessary to allow crews to safely complete a task. Thank you for your patience.
